cover letter
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training

Minimum of 4 years of experience demonstrating advanced skills and experience as a writer, able to clearly, engagingly, and persuasively convey complex messages in long form and short form, in a variety of media including electronic and print, and in tone and style at levels of detail and technical depth for diverse audiences.
Minimum of 4 years of experience with content development, research and fact verification, adherence to appropriate editorial style guidelines; copyediting, and proofreading.

Minimum of 4 years of experience with demonstrated ability to maintain good working relationships with internal and external partners, as well as ability to work collaboratively with partners and facilitate collaborations with teams/colleagues from varying fields and at all levels.
Donor Engagement and Stewardship Writer
Research, write, and edit high-level donor engagement materials - 40%

provides stewardship reporting, donor engagement communications, and proposal development support for all five divisions of the College of Letters & Science (L&S). With input from divisional development teams and college leadership and guidance from the Associate Director for Stewardship & Strategy, this position conceives, researches, writes, edits, and publishes written materials and strategic communications including feature stories, interviews, proposals, short videos, event scripts, and decanal presentations. The Donor Engagement and Stewardship Writer is also responsible for producing stewardship reports of varying lengths that are required by gift agreements to ensure donors and prospects are engaged and stewarded effectively to maintain and increase fundraising levels.

Research, write, and edit high-level donor engagement materials for all five divisions in the College of Letters & Science that communicate complex or sensitive subject matter, such as research outcomes, program activities, and student success stories, to a highly influential audience of major donors and philanthropic partners to UC Berkeley.
Collateral may include feature stories, interviews, proposals, briefing materials, talking points, decanal outreach communications to prospects and donors, and web site content.
Develop new donor engagement tools, including digital and print communications and collateral around key divisional and campaign priorities.
Research, write, and edit impact reports and other stewardship materials - 30%

Research, write, and edit impact reports and other stewardship materials for all five divisions in the College of Letters & Science as part of the approximately 125 stewardship moves for programmatic support or fund donors the Constituent Programs team produces annually.
Collaborate with divisional fundraising teams - 15%

Meet regularly with divisional fundraising teams in the Arts & Humanities, Biological Sciences, Mathematical & Physical Sciences, and Social Sciences divisions to understand priorities and recent program successes and advise on donor outreach and engagement strategies.
Provide donor engagement support for digital fundraising efforts - 5%
Work with UDAR and L&S leaders to develop strategies for digital outreach campaigns for the College of Letters & Science Leadership Fund; and produce donor engagement content for fundraising efforts.
Provide support for other L&S advancement communications - 5%

May collaborate with L&S College Relations and university staff on additional advancement communications projects, including campaign documents, website articles, proposals, event invitations, press releases, and miscellaneous donor reports.
Provides editing and proofreading support - 5%
Provides editing and proofreading support for L&S fundraisers and Constituent Programs team.
Advanced knowledge of the fundamentals of writing, grammar, syntax, style, and punctuation.
Knowledge of the campus, including its mission, goals, achievements, infrastructure, programs, and policies and/or the ability to learn.
Excellent team collaboration and interpersonal communications skills, including active listening, facilitation, conflict resolution, and political acumen.
Knowledge of Microsoft Suite, Google Suite, and marketing applications, such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud and Adobe Creative Suite and/or the ability to learn.
Advanced research and fact verification skills.
Knowledge of issues in higher education, development and/or a specialized academic discipline or field.
Advanced interpersonal communications skills, including active listening and effective collaboration.
Advanced analytical and critical thinking skills.
Skill to maintain absolute confidentiality.
